groups.description: Neovascular AMD (AREDS level 2 or higher), treatment-naive

exclusions.what: t0003 and t0004 BCVA logMAR mean ± SD (row R3, baseline to 12 months), both groups
exclusions.reason: Participants who dropped out within 1 year were excluded from analysis, and patients whose aflibercept course was skipped (contraindication or no consent) were excluded (Methods): a complete-case set at the last tabulated visit (12 months), with eyes removed from every visit after post-baseline events. No record.

exclusions.what: t0005 polypoidal lesion (+) and (-) subgroups of pachychoroid neovasculopathy
exclusions.reason: The same analysis set; 'final conditions' are undated.

exclusions.what: t0001 BCVA logMAR at baseline and 12 months
exclusions.reason: The same eyes and analysis set as t0003 and t0004.

notes: Retrospective comparative case series; three monthly aflibercept injections, then every 2 months (3 + 4 injections in 12 months).
History of CNV treatment was an exclusion criterion (treatment-naive); only the right eye was used when both eyes were eligible.
Landolt chart acuity was converted to logMAR for the analysis; the tables state logMAR.
